interface.title: ReVSeq Dashboard: Respiratory virus surveillance in Switzerland
interface.field: Genomic epidemiology / public-health virology (respiratory virus surveillance)
interface.stage_of_work: Reviewing and reporting results: browsing finished sequencing and PCR surveillance data
interface.what_it_is_for: Browsing weekly respiratory-virus detections by sequencing and PCR, per virus and per Swiss canton, with genome-coverage (pileup) plots, a co-infection heatmap and slots for phylogenetic trees.

data.note: Demo dataset bundled with the server: 31 sequences and 29 PCR detections across 13 strains, weeks 2026/01–2026/08. Pileup data exists only for SARS-CoV-2 and RSV. Co-infection samples are MIX-001 (SARS-CoV-2 + RSV-A, sequencing), MIX-003 (Influenza A + Metapneumovirus, sequencing) and MIX-002 (Influenza A + RSV, PCR). MIX-002's PCR hover reads 'Match Sequencing: Yes', but the Sequencing heatmap has no Influenza A × RSV cell, so the two views look inconsistent in this dataset. No uploads were used.

drag the week slider or click a week tick
or press ▶ to animate through weeks and ◼ to stop (stop not replay-confirmed)

Reset to undo zoom or pan (not replay-confirmed)

features.name: Assay toggle that drives linked panels

click PCR (or Sequencing)
read the updated total, barplot and map or heatmap

features.name: Time-binned count bars with cross-method agreement tooltip
features.general: Stacked or coloured bar chart over time where hovering a bar shows the count and how many of those items the other method also confirmed; legend clicks hide or isolate categories
features.specific: Sequencing/PCR barplots coloured by Strain (home) or Substrain (Sequencing view on strain pages). The hover reads 'Match PCR / weekly total' or 'Match Sequencing / weekly total'. The hover's 'Week' field and the x-axis ticks show month-year (e.g. 02-26 = February 2026), not an ISO week number. A legend click hides a strain or substrain and a double-click isolates it
steps: hover a bar to read count and match fraction (the 'Week' value is month-year)
click a legend entry to hide that category
double-click a legend entry to isolate it
hover again to read the isolated values
serves_tasks: Check how often two detection methods agree on the detections in one time bin
Focus the overview on a single pathogen

features.name: Genome coverage (pileup) viewer with gene track
features.general: Plot read depth along a genome on a log scale above an aligned gene-annotation track. Switch between a summary band (median + IQR across samples) and one trace per sample, and zoom to a region to see which gene it falls in
features.specific: Pileup panel with 'All samples' (Median line + IQR band) and 'Individuals' tabs above the orf1ab/S/…/N (SARS-CoV-2) or NS1…L (RSV) gene track. Hover gives Position/Median depth or Sample/Position/Depth; box-zoom also zooms the gene track. The dashboard's configuration also enables a per-subtype (substrain) depth level and a segment choice for segmented viruses; neither was seen here because only SARS-CoV-2 and RSV pileups were seeded
steps: read the All samples median and IQR curve for dips
hover a dip to read position and median depth
switch to Individuals and hover traces to name failed or outlier samples
box-drag to zoom on a region (gene track follows) and double-click to reset
toggle Median/IQR from the legend
serves_tasks: Find genome regions with low read depth across all samples
Find individual samples that failed or differ from the rest
Zoom into a low-coverage region to see which gene it falls in

features.name: Co-occurrence heatmap with marginal frequency bars
features.general: Upper-triangle matrix of category pairs found together in the same item, with a bar chart above showing each category's co-occurrence rate. Hovering a cell lists the items behind it
features.specific: Co-infection heatmap (Pair count) with a Frequency (%) bar per strain. The cell hover lists samples as 'ID | date | canton | Match PCR/Sequencing'; the bar hover gives co-infected samples, total detections and substrain frequencies; switchable Sequencing/PCR
steps: read the pair counts in the heatmap
hover a cell to list the co-infected samples with date, canton and cross-method match
hover a frequency bar for the co-infected / total ratio
switch Sequencing/PCR to compare

open_fixes: Placeholder tasks for phylogenetic placement on the strain page and for the per-sample co-infection depth drill-down were not added. The run never got a result for either (blank tree iframes; 'Pileup not available'), so a new run with Nextstrain reachable and MIX-* pileup data seeded is needed. Both stay in not_done and screens_never_reached for now.
